applies_to: AGC 200 series software 4.68.2.x, genset (DG) application only.
summary: The AGC 200 is DEIF's compact paralleling genset controller. Its Modbus RTU server is reached over RS-485 with option H2. This map lists the genset-variant AC measurements, energy and hour counters, DC supply, status flags and the control command words for remote start, stop, breaker and mode changes.

addressing.note: The 'Modbus address' column is what goes in the request. A 6-digit PLC address one higher is also printed (input 501 = PLC 300502).

source.title: AGC 200 Modbus tables
source.pages: Spreadsheet sheets 'Holding register (03;06;16)', 'Input register (04)', 'Discrete input contact (02)', DG column

notes: The source is an Excel workbook. Each row has a scaling exponent x; the value is raw x 10^-x, so x=2 means scale 0.01. Units are as printed.

32-bit values: the tables mark every 32-bit register with data format ABCD (high word at the lower address); DEIF's AGC 150 Modbus server manual (4189341435, section 3.4) uses the same notation with that meaning.
Only rows marked for the DG (genset) application are listed.
Left out: the configurable area, multi-input values, the engine-interface block marked 'See DRH manual' (593 upward), alarm bits, power-management data and the command-flag coils.
Parameters are reached through address areas plus the parameter's USW address; see Option H2 Modbus communication AGC 200 (4189341208).
The option H2 document covers Modbus RTU on RS-485 only; it does not describe Modbus TCP for the AGC 200, so TCP is not listed here.

integration.summary: Read generator values from input registers 501-538 with function 04 and the mode status flags with function 02. Write holding register 5 or 6 with bit 0 set plus the command bit to start, stop or change mode.
integration.enable: Fit option H2 for RS-485 Modbus RTU; its settings are parameters 7500-7520 (parameter list 4189340605).
quirks: A command word is ignored unless bit 0 is 1 in the same write.
Function 04 addresses below 500 are a user-configurable copy area.
setup: Option H2 RS-485: 9600 or 19200 bit/s, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit.
gotchas: AC voltages, currents and powers are whole units (scale 1); frequency and power factor use 0.01, and DC supply voltage uses 0.1.
